version: CDC child schedule (edition not stated in section)
title: Routine hepatitis A vaccination: 2-dose series at age 12-23 months
action: Ensure child has received 2 doses of hepatitis A vaccine by age 2 years

derived.min: series is given at age 12-23 months, so children turning 2 in the measurement year are expected to have completed it
derived.max: restricts to the single birth cohort just past the 12-23 month window

derived.window: a child aged 2 at end of the measurement year was born no earlier than {MY-2}-01-01, so this window covers all doses since birth; it cannot stop at the 2nd birthday, so doses given after age 23 months also count

numerator.note: Minimum age 12 months and minimum 6-month interval between doses are not enforced; doses given before 12 months would be counted.
